column1: # Stage-6 operating points for a discrete card. The default sweep is the two
# enforced power limits 300 W (the card's default limit
#   knob  pl    value = enforced board power limit in W (nvidia-smi -pl); the point
#               NAME must be "<value>W" (the read-back check compares them). A value
#               below power.min_limit or above power.max_limit is skipped and recorded.
#   knob  lgc   value = an SM clock cap in MHz at the default power limit: an
#               name "lgc<value>". Not in the default sweep - select with --point.
#   default 1 = in the default sweep; gated is always 0 on a discrete card
